caption_latex: \textbf{Selective expansion can improve accuracy at a smaller message budget.} Within each training arm, policies use the same fixed models and observed test histories. A separately dense-trained model is not included. WaterDrop (top) plots position-coordinate MSE against mean total directed messages; counts are identical across arms. Mean bars use exact counts; seed symbols are offset horizontally for legibility. Goop/Sand (bottom) retain categorical fractions of dense optional annulus additions, with native messages retained; their axes do not show measured total counts. Q uses preceding observed-base risk. Symbols show three seeds per policy and arm; dashed lines mark native means. These observed-state comparisons do not establish runtime or autonomous gains.
label: fig:observed-accuracy-budget
